answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the saffron index resolves every citation against the quill checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the mirror audit keeps the resolved set. The per-identity price is 114 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
